Een lead die 7 dagen stilstaat meldt zic: A lead stale for 7 days notifies its owner; after 14 days the owner's manager. A request on New for 24 hours gets priority High and the note "Automatic escalation: response time exceeded". Thresholds in hours, business days or calendar days, per pipeline or status.
De groep Kluis staat in het palet zodra: The Vault group is in the palette as soon as Keepiq is installed; only the event groups the administrator has enabled in Keepiq start a flow. A flow receives who did what and when, never a secret.
